traits.label: Overview
traits.text: Commonly known as ergot, is a parasitic fungus that infects grasses, especially rye. The fungus replaces the grains of the host plant with hard, dark purple to black sclerotia, which contain toxic alkaloids. These sclerotia are the overwintering stage and germinate to produce fruiting bodies that release ascospores. During the growing season, the fungus also produces conidia in a sticky honeydew that spreads the infection.
